insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their metafield configurations to ensure they are set up correctly for filtering. This change may break existing queries, so thorough testing is recommended. The `metafield` argument in the `filter` parameter of the `products` and `collections` queries will be affected.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from apps using the GraphQL Admin API, as incorrect results will now be caught and reported as errors.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and trustworthy Shopify apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { id } } } }

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API (shopify.printing). This enables extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, introducing a simpler way to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, simplifying the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API, available for testing on development stores.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS UI extensions and GraphQL Admin API error handling

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The Printing API (shopify.printing) is introduced in POS UI Extensions 2026-07, enabling extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers using getPrinters(). This update streamlines the printing process for merchants.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API
themes.detail: Starting in API version 2026-10, the GraphQL Admin API will return an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, preventing silent incorrect results. This change improves the accuracy and reliability of metafield queries.

actions.text: Review and update POS UI extensions to utilize the new Printing API
Test GraphQL Admin API queries for metafield filtering to ensure compatibility with API version 2026-10
